text: Strict PH1B construction checkpoint passes on JVM, Scala.js FastOpt, and FullOpt: untrusted TriangleTable; bounded accumulating TopologyAudit; deterministic first-occurrence edge indexing; 3F face-corner storage; four locus4s domains; total local incidence; Region-based neighbors/incidence; and witnesses for bounds, repeated vertices, duplicate faces, orientation conflicts, nonmanifold edges, bow ties, unused vertices, and empty topology. Current suite: 11 tests per runtime.
